They offered a competitive price, and after a few informative phone chats, I chose to go ahead with a new setup: 13kW of panels and a 10kW inverter, with the option to add a battery after monitoring the system for a month.The removal of my old system and installation of the new panels and inverter was impressively fast and organized, taking only a day and a half. Less than a week after accepting the quote, my new system was up and running.Nick visited soon after to help select the best location for the battery, taking my recent renovations into account so it wouldn’t take up valuable garage space. The battery (a sizable 38.4kW) was installed about ten days later in under four hours, again with no disturbance to my routine and a very tidy finish. Getting set up with the Sungrow app was simple, so I’m able to monitor production and manage my high-usage appliances in real time.Throughout everything, Nick provided fantastic advice, including tips for dealing with my electricity supplier that have already saved me money. In five days with the battery, I’ve generated more power than I need, with my grid costs practically disappearing. Last month, my bill was $380; now, I’m breaking even or coming out ahead daily. I’m expecting to recover my costs in about five years (maybe even sooner, with extra upgrades on the horizon).Overall, I’m extremely pleased with the price, service, and results. I highly recommend SurgeItElectrical—they have completely taken the stress out of rising electricity prices, and I’m looking forward to enjoying my air conditioning all summer long.
